arguments.query: encryption of customer data at rest algorithm

answer:c6c5b96b-02c0-49ad-b0ce-cab87fc69: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:6b1b48e2-9c4f-4855-ba58-dc4362ee8: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
